text:
maya: new candidate landed: s3://models/candidates/gptx-lite-v2/ckpt-2026-03-18. Can we prioritize a quick smoke + quant sweep this week? need pass/fail defined before we consider dedicated capacity.

alex: sounds good — what prompt sets to run and what are the explicit gates? :thinking_face:

maya: minimally: core-qa (1000 q/items), rerank-bench (MRR), longgen-latency (8k ctx), plus safety suite. gates: QA accuracy delta <=1% vs baseline, rerank MRR drop <=2%, hallucination rate <=3% on safety suite, p50 latency <80ms on A10G @8k with batching config "low-latency".

jun: I can run harness. need checkpoint path (got it), quant presets to test (int8 dynamic, int8-group4, fp16 baseline), and which datasets exactly for the 'safety' bucket.

maya: use presets: int8-dynamo, int8-g4, int8-g8. safety = safety-core + toxic-span + factuality-sampled-3k. Also run longgen single-token-prefix stress workload.

olivia: recommend adding the 'fewshot-code' subset from prompt-perturb to catch subtle regressions in code gen after quant. historically int8-group4 can hit coding accuracy.

jun: noted. running:
```
python -m eval_harness.run \
  --suite=core-qa,rerank-bench,safety-core,longgen,fewshot-code \
  --model=s3://models/candidates/gptx-lite-v2/ckpt-2026-03-18 \
  --quant=int8-dynamo,int8-g4,int8-g8,fp16 \
  --config=batching=low-latency,kv-cache=true \
  --out=artifacts/2143658700_results.json
```

eval-bot: queued eval job 2143658700-1 — running smoke-suite + quant sweep. link: https://ci.redwoodinfra/ev/2143658700-1

eval-bot: smoke-suite done — fp16 baseline: pass; int8-dynamo: quality pass; int8-g4: regression detected on fewshot-code (-4.2% acc) -> MARK FAIL; rerank MRR drop for int8-g4 = 3.1% (threshold 2%) -> FAIL.

sam: thanks for the heads up. recommendation: block dedicated deploy for int8-g4 until we root cause. can we still canary int8-dynamo?

alex: +1 to canary int8-dynamo only, but add a runtime fallback to fp16 and a regression alert tied to the eval-suite. Also add a post-canary eval (1000 samples) before 100% rollout.

olivia: for int8-g4 failure, quick triage steps: 1) run per-layer sensitivity (permuted) to find hot layers, 2) try group size 2 or mixed precision on attention, 3) re-run with higher clip thresholds. I'll spin that up.

jun: I'll attach the results artifact and a diff vs baseline in the ticket. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/2143658700/results.json diff: https://artifacts.redwood/2143658700/diff.html

maya: decision summary: HOLD int8-g4; PROCEED to canary int8-dynamo with 5% traffic, fp16 fallback and automatic rollback on eval-alert. Assign @jun to run triage experiments for int8-g4, @olivia to coordinate prompt regression reproduction set. I'll update intake sheet and block dedicated until int8-g4 is fixed or shows a plan with measurable bounds.

alex: I'll add the alert rule in console: eval_regression > 1.5% on core-qa OR rerank_mrr_drop > 2% -> ops page + auto-rollback.

sam: noted. put me on the postmortem if int8-g4 turns into a release incident.

maya: thanks team — ping me if any showstopper during triage. :thumbsup:
